<reason>CON won by making the tool-mismatch decisive: inelastic shelter demand means restraint hits incomes first and rents last, buyer diversion plus rate-sensitive construction means demand effect is weakest where scarcity is worst while supply damage is strongest, and lagging shelter risks overtightening.
